cohort: The study included 162 caregivers of children and youth with special healthcare needs (CYSHCN), mostly caring for children aged 2-17, recruited from the north central Appalachian region of the United States.
finding: Caregiver wellbeing was associated with various sociodemographic characteristics and HCBS access; challenges with HCBS access were related to psychological distress but also to posttraumatic growth and meaning in life.
